France Blames Iran for Cyberattack on Supermarket Fridges

France has blamed Iran for a cyberattack that targeted approximately 700 supermarkets, affecting refrigerators and freezers. French authorities have launched an investigation and stated they will pursue European sanctions against those responsible. The suspicion for the attack initially pointed elsewhere before investigators identified evidence linking it to Iran. The cyber unit "Shahid Kaveh" has been identified as being tied to the attack.
